reason: 该插件的核心用途是为 DeepSeek Harness Web 平台提供一个可交互的 Live2D 桌宠界面，集中体现在右下角显示、拖拽、角色/换装切换与动作交互，源代码结构与 README 均体现其为前端界面增强与桌面化小组件功能，未展示外部服务接入或自动化工作流能力。

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 平台的桌面宠物插件，可在页面中显示可拖拽的 Live2D 看板娘，并支持角色切换、换装和交互对话台词。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that displays a draggable Live2D desktop pet in the interface, with character switching, costume changes, and interactive behavior.

capabilities: Injects a web client UI module into the DeepSeek Harness web interface
Renders animated Live2D character graphics from bundled assets
Stores view position/state in browser localStorage for continuity

reasons.code: README lists right-lower-corner floating mascot, drag/click/pet interactions, costume switching, and greeting/祝福 features, indicating interactive on-page UI behavior.
Source tree includes web client entry (src/client/index.ts), static asset routing (src/routes.ts), and assets/model/vendor directories used to provide rendering resources locally.
Package manifest declares `dsh.client.platform: web` and includes a web bundle patch path, confirming this is a web-hosted plugin runtime.
